mapper.select:
SELECT B.RESOURCE_ID, B.URL, B.TYPE, T.NAME, T.DESCRIPTION, B.LOGIN_REQUIRE, B.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER, B.REQUEST_ID, B.PROGRAM_ID, B.CREATION_DATE, B.CREATED_BY, B.LAST_UPDATED_BY, B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, B.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN, B.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY, B.ATTRIBUTE1, B.ATTRIBUTE2, B.ATTRIBUTE3, B.ATTRIBUTE4, B.ATTRIBUTE5, B.ATTRIBUTE6, B.ATTRIBUTE7, B.ATTRIBUTE8, B.ATTRIBUTE9, B.ATTRIBUTE10, B.ATTRIBUTE11, B.ATTRIBUTE12, B.ATTRIBUTE13, B.ATTRIBUTE14, B.ATTRIBUTE15 FROM SYS_RESOURCE_B B LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS_RESOURCE_TL T ON(B.RESOURCE_ID = T.RESOURCE_ID AND T.LANG = #{request.locale,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) JOIN SYS_FUNCTION_RESOURCE SFR ON(B.RESOURCE_ID=SFR.RESOURCE_ID AND SFR.FUNCTION_ID=#{function.functionId,jdbcType=DECIMAL})
AND B.URL LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{resource.url,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND T.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{resource.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND B.TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{resource.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND T.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{resource.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
ORDER BY B.RESOURCE_ID

SELECT B.RESOURCE_ID, B.URL, B.TYPE, T.NAME, T.DESCRIPTION, B.LOGIN_REQUIRE, B.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER, B.REQUEST_ID, B.PROGRAM_ID, B.CREATION_DATE, B.CREATED_BY, B.LAST_UPDATED_BY, B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, B.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN, B.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY, B.ATTRIBUTE1, B.ATTRIBUTE2, B.ATTRIBUTE3, B.ATTRIBUTE4, B.ATTRIBUTE5, B.ATTRIBUTE6, B.ATTRIBUTE7, B.ATTRIBUTE8, B.ATTRIBUTE9, B.ATTRIBUTE10, B.ATTRIBUTE11, B.ATTRIBUTE12, B.ATTRIBUTE13, B.ATTRIBUTE14, B.ATTRIBUTE15 FROM SYS_RESOURCE_B B LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS_RESOURCE_TL T ON(B.RESOURCE_ID = T.RESOURCE_ID AND T.LANG = #{request.locale,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
B.RESOURCE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SFR.RESOURCE_ID FROM SYS_FUNCTION_RESOURCE SFR WHERE SFR.FUNCTION_ID = #{function.functionId,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND SFR.RESOURCE_ID IS NOT NULL)
AND B.URL LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{resource.url,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND T.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{resource.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
ORDER BY B.RESOURCE_ID

SELECT SFB.FUNCTION_ID, SFB.MODULE_CODE, SFB.FUNCTION_ICON, SFB.FUNCTION_SEQUENCE, SFB.FUNCTION_CODE, SFT.FUNCTION_NAME, SFT.FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION, SFB.RESOURCE_ID, SFB.TYPE, SFB.PARENT_FUNCTION_ID, SFT.LANG FROM SYS_FUNCTION_B SFB LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS_FUNCTION_TL SFT ON (SFB.FUNCTION_ID = SFT.FUNCTION_ID) WHERE SFT.LANG IS NOT NULL

select sfb.FUNCTION_ID, sfb.MODULE_CODE, sfb.FUNCTION_NAME_ID, sfb.FUNCTION_ICON, sfb.FUNCTION_CODE, sfb.FUNCTION_NAME, sfb.FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION, sfb.RESOURCE_ID, sfb.TYPE, sfb.PARENT_FUNCTION_ID, sfb.FUNCTION_SEQUENCE, sfb.FUNCTION_TYPE, sfb.HEIGHT, sfb.WIDTH, sfb.HOMEPAGE_RESOURCE_ID, sfb.TOOLBAR_FLAG, sfb.DESCRIPTION_ID, sfb.ICON, sfb.SEQUENCE, sfb.SERVICE_ID, srm.ENABLED_FLAG, srm.SYS_ROLE_MODULE_ID, srm.ROLE_ID, srm.PARENT_MODULE_CODE, srb.URL, srb. NAME, srb.DESCRIPTION, srb.LOGIN_REQUIRE, srb.ACCESS_CHECK, srb.LOCKED_BY, sm.MODULE_NAME, sm.MODULE_DESCRIPTION, sm.MODULE_SERIAL_NUMBER, sm.MODULE_ICON, sm.BACKGROUND_COLOR, sm.OPEN_MODE, sm.MODULE_LEVEL, (select sm.MODULE_NAME from sys_module sm where sm.MODULE_CODE = srm.PARENT_MODULE_CODE) PARENT_MODULE_NAME from sys_function_b sfb,sys_role_module srm,sys_resource_b srb,sys_module sm where sfb.MODULE_CODE = srm.MODULE_CODE and sfb.RESOURCE_ID = srb.RESOURCE_ID and srm.role_id = #{roleId} and srm.MODULE_CODE = sm.MODULE_CODE and not EXISTS (select * from sys_role_module_exclude_func srmef where srmef.FUNCTION_ID = sfb.function_id and srmef.role_id = #{roleId} and srmef.module_code = sm.MODULE_CODE )
and ( sfb.function_code like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{functionCode},'%')) or sfb.function_name like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{functionCode},'%')) )
order by sfb.function_sequence asc

select sfb.*, srm.role_id, srm.sys_role_module_id, srb.name, srb.url, sm.module_name, (select sm.MODULE_NAME from sys_module sm where sm.MODULE_CODE = srm.PARENT_MODULE_CODE) PARENT_MODULE_NAME from sys_function_b sfb,sys_role_module srm,sys_resource_b srb,sys_module sm where sfb.MODULE_CODE = srm.MODULE_CODE and sfb.RESOURCE_ID = srb.RESOURCE_ID and srm.role_id = #{roleId} and srm.MODULE_CODE = sm.MODULE_CODE and not EXISTS (select * from sys_role_module_exclude_func srmef where srmef.FUNCTION_ID = sfb.function_id and srmef.role_id = #{roleId} )
and ( sfb.function_code like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{functionCode},'%')) or sfb.function_name like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{functionCode},'%')) )
order by sfb.function_sequence asc

SELECT sfb.function_code, sfb.function_name, sfb.function_id, sfb.function_description, ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT count(*) FROM sys_role_module_exclude_func smc WHERE smc.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND smc.role_id = #{roleId} AND smc.function_id = sfb.function_id ) = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AS enabled_flag FROM sys_function_b sfb WHERE sfb.module_code = #{moduleCode}

SELECT sfb.function_code, sfb.function_name, sfb.function_id, sfb.function_description, ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT count(*) FROM sys_function_b sb, sys_role_module_exclude_func smc WHERE smc.role_id = #{roleId} AND smc.function_id = sfb.function_id ) = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AS enabled_flag FROM sys_function_b sfb

SELECT SFB.FUNCTION_ID AS functionId, SFB.FUNCTION_CODE AS functionCode, SFB.FUNCTION_NAME AS functionName, SFB.ENABLED_FLAG AS enabledFlag, SFB.MODULE_CODE AS moduleCode, SFB.FUNCTION_SEQUENCE AS functionSequence, SFBP.FUNCTION_CODE parentFunctionCode, SRB.URL AS resourceUrl FROM SYS_FUNCTION_B SFB LEFT JOIN SYS_FUNCTION_B SFBP ON SFB.PARENT_FUNCTION_ID = SFBP.FUNCTION_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_RESOURCE_B SRB ON SFB.RESOURCE_ID = SRB.RESOURCE_ID
